name: Director Orion
description: Provides mission briefings, long-term guidance and occasional feedback. Rarely gives direct answers, preferring questions that encourage investigation.
personality: A mentor who values careful questioning over quick answers.
knowledge: Keeper of Academy records; oversees the Expedition Network.
relationships: Welcomes the learner at the start of the campaign (Mission 1) and again at Graduation (Mission 21).

name: Atlas
description: Manages mission logistics, records discoveries, delivers recovered archives, and offers procedural hints when required. Explains how to investigate but not what to conclude, preserving learner independence.
personality: Helpful and procedural; deliberately withholds conclusions so the learner reasons for themselves.
knowledge: Station systems, mission logistics, safety and procedural guidance.

name: Dr. Elara Quinn
role: Lead scientist of the missing expedition
description: Known only through journals, recordings and research notes during most of the campaign. Her work provides the narrative thread connecting otherwise independent investigations.
knowledge: Led the original Outpost Echo expedition; her final report (Mission 19) explains why the expedition suspended operations rather than risk publishing unverified conclusions.

name: The Original Expedition Team
description: A diverse group of researchers specialising in Biology, Engineering, Astronomy, Mathematics and Environmental Science. Encountered only through recovered artefacts and records, allowing each mission to reveal another piece of the larger story.
